points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 308ffdad clean build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench; zero CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/case/output and optional restart/report-level; restart is explicitly unimplemented.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, case, flux, partition, halo, reconstruction and output are modular; MPI output and transient statistics need work.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal external-solver call found; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case configuration and generic case paths; no two-mesh-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root METIS partition/scatter and neighbor halo exist, but output.cpp writes rank0 local field/surface only; no rank comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Three laminar residual histories include 11,160–24,129 nonfinite entries; all six statuses failed and cylinders incomplete.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Zero CTests; official validator rejects first failed final metadata. No completed rank comparison or test result.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clear C++ modules but unimplemented restart, rank0-only output and uncommitted report figures limit reproducibility.

disqualification_flags.evidence: See the explicit trigger-7 finding in the top-level disqualification assessment.
